MAGICKAL (cite: Garrod_2013) is a three-phase model used to calculate and solve the coupled rate equations that govern the chemistry occurring in the gas, grain-surface, and bulk-ice phases.
The full grid of physical parameters is varied to test every combination; this results in a total of 84 stage-1 models.
The total number of stage-2 model runs is thus 756.

where $A_\mathrm{V,initial}$ assumes a value of either 2 or 3 mag (cite: Garrod_2022).
